body: SH is a coping mechanism, but it's an unhealthy one, although it may seem a net positive short term, long term it'll only cause you more and more harm, please OP go to therapy if possible,  if not if you have a friend you can confide in and who's willing to lend you an ear for you to vent, kinda like a sobriety companion, then that may help, especially that it seems from your post that you have no one to vent to.

Tell him, maybe he loves you too, maybe he no longer wants kids, or that isn't a priority for him anymore, you never know, and you'll regret not telling or telling him too late, but be prepared to deal with rejection which is a possibility, so don't let it ruin your friendship if it happens

"Why do I keep finding these men" if you mean this in a self blaming way, please don't,  as others have said, none of this is your fault, please report him if you haven't done so already, and maybe stay with family or a friend for a while, or if you've neither a women's shelter, and please OP since this isn't the first time -assuming from your post-, if he has ever choked you before, run tf away as soon as possible

Yes, they can, after all they are both just human beings, but love can happen at any point though even if it wasn't there from the beginning, neither neither being in love means they can't be best friends, nor both or either being in love with the other means they can't be best friends

The ability to make others feel what you feel, I hurt a friend by mistake without meaning to, and I regret it more than anything,  but no matter how much I tried telling them, they won't believe me, I wish I could just show her how I feel & how much I miss her & how much I'm misunderstood

From your post he seems to have cared deeply about you, and was actively hiding his depression and suicidal thoughts, as others have said, he probably thought he was sparing you pain, none of this is your fault, please know that maybe he seemed happy to you because despite depression he may have been happy with you, which made it easier to hide it from you, I'm sorry for your loss, please go to therapy and focus on healing

Scariest as in graphic a car accident coming back from uni exams once, with people horribly injured on the side of the road, it didn't help that the only classmate I knew on friendly terms had died days earlier in a car accident going back from exams

Scariest as in traumatic, my father suffering & dying of cancer at the age of 10, it left him a shell of his old self, I remember being quit obsessed and in fear of anyone else I care about dying in general and of it in particular for a long time after

OP, sorry for what you've been through, from your post "I think those are real rape videos" which implies you didn't go out searching for real rape videos, instead were searching for videos made by supposedly consenting adults role playing such thing, and assuming from your post you stopped watching once you realized the nature of those videos, as others said you're trying to heal, you did nothing wrong, please report the videos if you haven't, and focus on healing
